items.title: What the CFTC’s New Crypto Reserves Guidance Actually Allows—And What It Doesn’t
items.body: Staff guidance lets swap venues and clearinghouses count Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins toward their 12-month operating-cost buffer. Here's the catch.

items.title: BTCS sells more than half its ether to repay $43.8 million in Aave debt
items.body: The firm's DeFi business, Imperium, temporarily pulled out of liquidity pools after generating $3.5 million in Q3 revenue.

items.title: Ethereum Foundation doubles protocol security team ahead of overhaul
items.body: The foundation said its next upgrade will be harder than the Merge, and the required pace of development will make it easier to ship bugs.

items.title: BTCS offloads $44M in ETH to reduce DeFi debt amid market downturn
items.body: BTCS sold more than half its Ether holdings to reduce leverage following the market sell-off, while BitMine added another 7,819 ETH to its treasury.

items.title: Tom Lee Says Ethereum Is as Scarce as Bitcoin—And Bitmine Just Bought More
items.body: Chairman Tom Lee argued ETH’s supply has grown just 0.90% annually since mid-2025—roughly matching Bitcoin’s 0.82% and far below Solana, XRP and Cardano.
